/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsOutNoticeList : 반출통고 리스트 조회 */
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , SUM(AA.SIMPLE_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_SIMPLE_CNT , SUM(AA.GENERAL_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_GENERAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT B.OUT_NOTICE_NO , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 tcfs.REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE tcfs WHERE A.OD_JOB_NO = tcfs.FUNC_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , A.OD_JOB_NO , A.CARRYIN_DATE , B.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , B.PERIOD_OVER_DATE , B.BL_NO , B.MBL_NO , B.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'N', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT , B.PKG_TYPE , ISNULL(B.NOTICE_CT, 0) AS NOTICE_CT , ISNULL(B.NOTICE_WT, 0) AS NOTICE_WT , B.CUSTOMER_CODE , B.CUSTOMER_NAME , B.CUSTOMER_ZIPCODE , B.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , B.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(B.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, B.CUSTOMER_TEL, 1) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , B.CUSTOMER_REMARKS , A.SHIPPER_CODE , A.SHIPPER_NAME , A.CONSIGNEE_CODE , A.CONSIGNEE_NAME , A.NOTIFY_CODE , A.NOTIFY_NAME , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , A.LOCATION_PLACE , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , B.PRINT_YN , B.IN_NO , B.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE B.REGISTER_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , B.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , B.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE B.UPDATE_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , B.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , 'NOTICE' AS SRCH_GBN
, '조회' AS blStatus
, (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = B.LAST_POD_STATUS AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO') AS LAST_POD_STATUS , A.CD_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.CD_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE') AS CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.CD_USE_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE , A.IN_CLASS + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.IN_CLASS AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYIN_TYPE') AS IN_CLASS
, B.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE , A.IN_CLASS
FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE B LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND 1 = 0
) AA

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsOutNoticeOmittedList : 누락통보 리스트 조회 */
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , SUM(AA.SIMPLE_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_SIMPLE_CNT , SUM(AA.GENERAL_CNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_GENERAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT B.OUT_NOTICE_PLAN_NO , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 tcfs.REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE tcfs WHERE A.OD_JOB_NO = tcfs.FUNC_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , B.OUT_NOTICE_YN , A.CARRYIN_DATE , A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , B.PERIOD_OVER_DATE , B.BL_NO , B.MBL_NO , B.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'N', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.PKG_TYPE , A.LOCATION_PLACE , B.IN_LOC_CODE , ISNULL(B.INOUT_NOTICE_PLAN_CT, 0) AS INOUT_NOTICE_PLAN_CT , ISNULL(B.INOUT_NOTICE_PLAN_WT, 0) AS INOUT_NOTICE_PLAN_WT , A.XRAY_LINE_NO , ISNULL(A.XRAY_SCAN_CT, 0) AS XRAY_SCAN_CT , ISNULL(A.XRAY_IMAGE_CT, 0) AS XRAY_IMAGE_CT , A.OD_JOB_NO , B.IN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.IN_APPROVAL_NO , A.TRANS_PERIOD_DATE , A.CUSTOMER_CODE , A.CUSTOMER_NAME , A.SHIPPER_CODE , A.SHIPPER_NAME , A.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1 , A.CONSIGNEE_CODE , A.CONSIGNEE_NAME , A.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_TEL, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , A.NOTIFY_CODE , A.NOTIFY_NAME , A.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_1 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.NOTIFY_TEL, 1) AS NOTIFY_TEL , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , A.CNTR_NO , A.ORIG_COUNTRY , A.REFERENCE_NO , A.CARRYOUT_DATE , A.CARRYOUT_TIME , B.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE B.REGISTER_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , B.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , 'OMITTED' AS SRCH_GBN
, '조회' AS blStatus
, A.CD_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.CD_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE') AS CD_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.ECM_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE') AS ECM_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.CD_USE_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE') AS INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE') AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'INSPECTION_TYPE') AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE') AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , A.XRAY_CHECK + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.XRAY_CHECK AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'XRAY_INSPECTION_TYPE') AS XRAY_CHECK , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE') AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , A.IN_CLASS + '.' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det WHERE det.CODE = A.IN_CLASS AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'CARRYIN_TYPE') AS IN_CLASS
, A.CD_TYPE , A.ECM_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , A.XRAY_CHECK , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , A.IN_CLASS
FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE_PLAN B LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO WHERE 1=1
AND 1 = 0
) AA

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsOutNoticeDetail : 등록 ENTRY - 반출통고 1건 상세 */ SELECT OUT_NOTICE_NO , IN_NO , BL_NO , MBL_NO , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , OUT_NOTICE_DATE , PERIOD_OVER_DATE , PKG_TYPE , NOTICE_CT , NOTICE_WT , CUSTOMER_CODE , CUSTOMER_NAME , CUSTOMER_ZIPCODE , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, CUSTOMER_TEL, 1) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , CUSTOMER_REMARKS , LAST_POD_DATE , LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , LAST_POD_STATUS , REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE REGISTER_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE UPDATE_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , UPDATE_DATE_TIME , 'NOTICE' AS srchGbn FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE WHERE 1=1 AND CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{srchCargoReferenceNo} AND IN_NO = #{srchInNo} ORDER BY OUT_NOTICE_NO DESC

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectInventoryDetail : 등록 ENTRY - 반입 1건 상세 */ SELECT TOP 1 A.IN_NO , A.OD_JOB_NO , A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , A.PERIOD_OVER_DATE , A.PKG_TYPE , A.CT , A.WT , A.CUSTOMER_CODE , A.CUSTOMER_NAME , (SELECT TOP 1 busi.ZIPCODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS busi WHERE busi.CUSTOMER_CODE = A.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_ZIPCODE , (SELECT TOP 1 busi.ADDRESS FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS busi WHERE busi.CUSTOMER_CODE = A.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , (SELECT TOP 1 busi.ADDRESS_A FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS busi WHERE busi.CUSTOMER_CODE = A.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , (SELECT TOP 1 busi.TEL FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS busi WHERE busi.CUSTOMER_CODE = A.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , A.LAST_POD_DATE , A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.LOCATION_PLACE , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.SIMPLE_AUTH_NAME , A.INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , A.XRAY_LINE_NO , A.XRAY_CHECK , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , A.CD_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE , A.AMOUNT_USD , A.CARRYIN_DATE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE A.REGISTER_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT TOP 1 tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE A.UPDATE_USER_ID = tsu.USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , B.HOLD_YN , B.HOLD_REASON , 'STOCK' AS srchGbn FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT '' AS HOLD_YN , MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , MAX(HOLD_CODE) AS HOLD_CODE , MAX(HOLD_REASON) AS HOLD_REASON , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_DATE) AS HOLD_RELEASE_DATE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO ) B ON A.OD_JOB_NO = B.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.IN_NO = #{srchInNo} ORDER BY A.IN_NO DESC
/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectErrorDesc : 등록 ENTRY - 오류내역 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 ERROR_DESC FROM GT_XML_GOVCBRR20 WHERE DECLARATION_NO = #{srchDeclarationNo} /* 화물관리번호 */ ORDER BY ERROR_NO DESC

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectInventoryListBySrchNo : 조회번호, 타입에 따라 반입 데이터 조회 */
SELECT A.IN_NO , A.CARRYIN_DATE , A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.IN_CLASS , A.MBL_NO , 'STOCK' AS SRCH_GBN FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE A.${srchNoType} = #{srchNo}
mapper.update: /* BmsOutNoticeMapper.updateOutNoticePrintYn : 반출통고 출력여부 수정 */ UPDATE TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE SET PRINT_YN = 'Y' WHERE OUT_NOTICE_NO IN(#{item.outNoticeNo})
mapper.select: /* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectOutNoticeInNoticeNoWithBms01 : */ SELECT notice.* , carryIn.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE notice LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN carryIn ON carryIn.IN_NO = notice.IN_NO WHERE notice.OUT_NOTICE_NO IN(#{item.outNoticeNo}) AND notice.LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS01'

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsInCalcOutNoticeDateByInNo : 반입번호에 해당하는 반입(재계산된 통고일자,체화일자 포함) 조회 */ SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, dbo.GET_DATE_DIFF_WORK_DAYS_FOR_NOTICE_DATE(CARRYIN_DATE, #{optionValue}, 'Y')), 23) AS OUT_NOTICE_DATE , dbo.GET_DATE_DIFF_WORK_DAYS_FOR_NOTICE_DATE(CARRYIN_DATE, #{optionValue}, 'Y') AS PERIOD_OVER_DATE , * FROM TB_BMS_IN WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IN_NO = #{inNo}

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsOutNoticeForExcelUpload : 엑셀업로드 - 반출통고 조회 */ SELECT A.IN_NO , A.OUT_NOTICE_NO , A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.MBL_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_NOTICE A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN tbi WITH (NOLOCK) ON tbi.IN_NO = A.IN_NO WHERE A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo}

/* BmsOutNoticeMapper.selectBmsInForExcelUpload : 엑셀업로드 - 반입 조회 */ SELECT A.IN_NO , A.CARRYIN_DATE , A.BL_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.IN_CLASS , A.MBL_NO , A.PKG_TYPE , A.STOCK_CT - outPlan.APPROVAL_CT AS CT , A.STOCK_WT - outPlan.APPROVAL_WT AS WT , A.CUSTOMER_CODE , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MONTH, -1, dbo.GET_DATE_DIFF_WORK_DAYS_FOR_NOTICE_DATE(A.CARRYIN_DATE, #{optionValue}, 'Y')), 23) AS OUT_NOTICE_DATE , dbo.GET_DATE_DIFF_WORK_DAYS_FOR_NOTICE_DATE(A.CARRYIN_DATE, #{optionValue}, 'Y') AS PERIOD_OVER_DATE FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) OUTER APPLY ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_CT, 0)), 0) AS APPROVAL_CT , ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_WT, 0)), 0) AS APPROVAL_WT FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN OP WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE OP.IN_NO = A.IN_NO AND OP.APPROVAL_CLASS = '31' AND OP.OUT_YN = 'N' ) outPlan WHERE A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} AND A.STOCK_CT - outPlan.APPROVAL_CT > 0
